name: Draft Assistant
description: Preview a rewritten draft or a predicted next message before copying it into chat

draftAssistant.endpoint.description: Full URL of an independent OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint. Use HTTPS or HTTP on loopback.

draftAssistant.model.description: Model served by the configured endpoint.

draftAssistant.enabled.description: Allow sending drafts and the current chat's latest exchange to the configured endpoint for inference.

draftAssistant.autoPredict.description: Generate a suggestion after a reply in the active chat when data sharing is enabled.
